crossRefs.note: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your…
since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
